_comment:
'You start the game with 1 weapon zone.' was NOT IMPLEMENTED, so Kayo played with the default 2 -- a second weapon, on the hero whose whole cost is having one. deck.py reads hero_def.setup.weapon_zones and the OTHER printing (kayo_underhanded_cheat) declares it; this one was missed. Swept every hero whose text sets a weapon-zone count: these two are the only ones, and this was the only mismatch.

The activation cost was '{r}{r}{r}{r}, {t}' and was authored as activation_cost 4 plus a PITCH of 1. Pitching a card is not tapping: the ability charged a card it does not ask for, and -- because nothing tapped -- could be activated repeatedly in a turn. TAP_SELF is both halves of that fix, and it is checkable (can_pay is false while tapped).

SET_BASE_POWER's 'target': 'attack_action' was unread and also redundant: the handler already restricts candidates to attack action cards the controller controls (controlled_attack_action_cards) and asks when several qualify. Removed so it does not read as a restriction that is doing work.
